evidence: Source review against the skill's procedure for check 15 (quality-checks.md:67-68). task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template environment/Dockerfile (diff empty; preflight 'canonical:environment/Dockerfile' passed). Pinned base: Dockerfile:1 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim', no --platform. Runtime dependencies pre-installed globally with exact versions: Dockerfile:9-11 'npm install -g ... express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1', resolved through Dockerfile:3 'ENV NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules', the same path test.sh:106 and :162 pass to the app and the same two versions tests/Dockerfile:20-21 install in the verifier image. Assets staged: Dockerfile:14 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', :15 'COPY assets/ /assets/', :16 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'; both COPY sources exist (six notes; seed_data.json parses as an object with snippets and note). /app is created, git-initialised and holds only .gitkeep (Dockerfile:17-23). No COPY/ADD of solution/ or tests/; the only build context is environment/. No install runs at agent start or grade time: CMD is 'sleep infinity' (Dockerfile:26), solve.sh only copies files (solve.sh:37-38, no npm/apt/pip), and task.toml sets no [environment].docker_image that would shadow the Dockerfile. The declared world matches the brief: integration.md:5 'The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH'. Weak-app probe: the golden server.js requires only node:path, node:fs, express and better-sqlite3 (server.js:2-5); its other package.json dependencies (react, prettier, acorn, @lezer/html) are bundled into the shipped public/assets/index.js, which contains no CDN fetch, so the reference needs nothing beyond the image. Conforming-alternative probe: a builder choosing another server library must vendor it under /app, which integration.md:5 and :11 state publicly ('Include everything needed at runtime', node_modules links allowed), so the two-package image does not silently fail a conforming app. Residuals, not defects under this row: (a) node:22-bookworm-slim is a floating tag rather than a digest and the apt packages on Dockerfile:5-6 are unversioned; both are template-controlled, and the workbook's check-dockerfiles.py row treats unpinned apt as a NOTE and a tagged base as pinned. (b) Not measured: no docker build of this frozen Dockerfile is hash-bound in raw-evidence-index.json. The scripted golden run used a pre-existing image tag (run_golden.sh:14 'cw-editor-agent-r3') whose provenance from these bytes is not recorded, so it is not build evidence for this candidate. I did not build the image in this read-only assignment. The Pass rests on source inspection only.
